title.zh: 【Bittensor 推出 eTAO，子网所有者可自定义排放分配比例】
title.en: 【Bittensor 推出 eTAO，子网所有者可自定义排放分配比例】

current_state.zh: Bittensor's Opentensor Foundation launched eTAO, letting subnet owners customize how alpha emissions are split among owners, validators, and miners while preserving root-network TAO staker protections.
current_state.en: Bittensor's Opentensor Foundation launched eTAO, letting subnet owners customize how alpha emissions are split among owners, validators, and miners while preserving root-network TAO staker protections.
